page_title: What do you want to build?

sources.entry: Devassistant.ai - Your AI Co-Programmer for Efficient Development #paid

summary.name: Devassistant.ai
summary.one_liner: An AI-guided service that takes a product idea, scopes the requirements, builds an MVP, and keeps the same thread going for later updates.
use_cases: turn a product idea into a working MVP
get ongoing updates on an early-stage product
hand off an app build to an AI-driven process
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a workflow where the user describes a product once, and Devassistant.AI tightens the requirements and defines the MVP before building it. It says the same conversation thread is kept alive from intake through delivery and for further update requests. The page emphasizes rigorous scoping before anything is built. Pricing is listed as a flat $10 per month plan covering ongoing updates, follow-up requests, and continued product support once the MVP is in motion. The page does not describe specific technologies, languages, or deployment options.
notable: Single thread from requirements intake through delivery and later updates
Scopes and defines the MVP before building
caveats: Paid: flat $10/month plan required for continued support
Page does not specify the tech stack, supported languages, or what the initial MVP build costs
